title: Clinic
description: One dialysis clinic or hospital. data/seed/clinics.json is an array of these.

id.description: C01, C02, ... for dialysis clinics; H01, ... for hospitals.

stations.description: Dialysis stations (CMS). null for a hospital.

late_shift.description: true when CMS SHIFT is Y. Only then can the clinic have shift 4 (late, 19:30 to 23:30).

home.description: true for exactly one clinic: Rosa's, inside the outage area.

kind.description: A hospital is the last resort only.

backup_power.description: A clinic inside the outage polygon closes unless this is full.

isolation_station.description: Needed to take a hep_b_positive patient.

slots.description: Open chairs per date and shift. A missing slot means no open chairs.

simulated.description: Fields that are simulated, not from CMS. The UI shows a Simulated tag on them.

shift.description: 1 = 06:00-10:00, 2 = 10:30-14:30, 3 = 15:00-19:00, 4 = late 19:30-23:30 (late_shift clinics only). Local time, America/Los_Angeles.
